newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Horse Racing-Hennessy Gold Cup betting update.
newsitem.headline: Horse Racing-Hennessy Gold Cup betting update.

text.p: Fergie Sutherland-trained Imperial Call was on Friday made the evens-favourite (from 5-4) for Sunday's Grade One Hennessy Gold Cup at Leopardstown.
A field of eight runners will contest the 100,000 Irish pounds ($159,900) presentation run over three miles (4.8-km).
Gordon Richards-trained The Grey Monk, at 4-1, heads the three-pronged British challenge while Jodami, winner of the Hennessy Gold Cup on three successive occasions starting in 1993, is quoted 11-2.
Ireland's latest equine star Danoli is an 8-1 chance, with Jim Dreaper's Merry Gale is 10-1.
Paul Nicholls-trained Belmont King (12-1), and Idiots Venture and King of the Gales (both at 33-1) complete the field.
